_note: Precise execution (#221). `prepAhead`: tasks that can be done days before, per recipe id. `sourcing`: where to look and what to ask for, per ingredient id. `keepDays`: how long cooked food keeps once refrigerated within 2 hours: 3 days for most leftovers and 2 for cooked rice and pasta (NSW Food Authority, Leftovers); salads and rolls are set to 1 day as a cautious call, not an official figure. Prep and sourcing text is general cooking guidance. A test checks every id against the library and catalogue.

spaghetti-bolognese.task: Make the sauce (steps 1 and 2) and keep it covered in the fridge. Reheat it until steaming on the day and cook the spaghetti fresh.

butter-chicken.task: Marinate the diced chicken in the yoghurt and half the spices, covered, in the fridge.

dahl.task: Simmer the lentils with the turmeric (step 1, without the rice), cool them quickly and keep them covered in the fridge. Reheat them until steaming before adding the onion mixture.

rice-paper-rolls.task: Simmer and slice the pork belly (step 1) and keep it covered in the fridge. Roll the rolls on the day.

vegetable-curry.task: Make the curry up to the end of step 3 (without the rice) and keep it covered in the fridge. Add the chickpeas, spinach and garam masala when you reheat it.

shaking-beef.task: Cut the beef and marinate it, covered, in the fridge. The marinade works in 15 minutes; overnight is fine.

lemongrass-chilli-chicken.task: Chop the lemongrass, garlic and chilli, and marinate the chicken with the fish sauce, sugar and turmeric, covered, in the fridge.

lemongrass-beef-noodle-salad.task: Make the dressing (step 1) and marinate the sliced beef (step 2), both covered in the fridge.

egg-fried-rice.task: Cook the rice, spread it on a tray to cool quickly, then refrigerate it covered. Day-old rice fries best.

sourcing.beef-rump: Butcher: rump steak, trimmed of fat. Ask for it cut into 3 cm cubes for shaking beef, or sliced thin for stir-fries.
sourcing.pork-belly: Butcher: a boneless, skinless slab, about 5 cm thick.
sourcing.pork-loin-chop: Butcher: loin chops about 2.5 cm thick, with the fat left on.
sourcing.cooked-prawns: Fishmonger or seafood counter: cooked prawns, shells on, bought the day you cook.
sourcing.lemongrass: Asian grocer or the fresh herb section: fresh stalks, not paste.
sourcing.rice-paper: Asian grocer or the international aisle: 22 cm round sheets.
sourcing.water-chestnuts: Asian grocer or the international aisle: tinned, whole or sliced.
sourcing.ground-almonds: Baking aisle: sold as almond meal.
